summary.text: Vickie Sawyer is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 37, covering Iredell and Mecklenburg counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Raygan Angel.
A business owner, she has served in the Senate since 2018.

paragraphs.text: Sawyer earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte in 1997, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as business owner.
Ballotpedia lists her Senate tenure as beginning in 2018.

The General Assembly's website shows Sawyer chairing the Appropriations on Department of Transportation Committee and the Transportation Committee and serving as vice chair of the Joint Legislative Transportation Oversight Committee.
The Republican primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
